mechanism: Quinidine inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase candesartan levels; both drugs can cause hypotension and affect electrolytes (potassium), with quinidine's antiarrhythmic effects potentially enhanced by candesartan-induced hemodynamic changes.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and serum potassium levels; consider dose adjustment of candesartan if hypotension develops; monitor for quinidine toxicity signs.
